SELECT d.id, d.company_id, COALESCE(c.short_name, c.name) AS company_name, d.partner_id, p.code AS partner_code, COALESCE(p.short_name, p.name) AS partner_name, d.biz_date, d.amount, d.reason, d.ref_no, d.version, st.id AS statement_id, st.no AS statement_no, st.status AS statement_status, d.create_by, d.create_time FROM stl_deduction d JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = d.company_id JOIN sup_supplier p ON p.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN stl_statement_item i ON i.source_type = 'DEDUCTION' AND i.source_id = d.id AND i.active LEFT JOIN stl_statement st ON st.id = i.statement_id WHERE true AND d.create_by = #{scope.userId}
AND p.product_lines && #{scope.lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[] AND d.company_id = #{q.companyId} AND d.partner_id = #{q.partnerId} AND d.biz_date >= #{q.dateFrom} AND d.biz_date <= #{q.dateTo} AND i.id IS NOT NULL AND i.id IS NULL
AND (d.reason LIKE #{kw} OR d.ref_no ILIKE #{kw} OR p.code ILIKE #{kw} OR p.name LIKE #{kw} OR p.short_name LIKE #{kw})
ORDER BY d.biz_date DESC, d.id DESC
